'tam' (him) = the recipient of the army. daṇḍa = army (Book 9 glossary). Troops: hereditary/hired/guild/ally/forest-tribe (9.2). upalabdha-deśa-kāla 'of ascertained place and time'; vyavahita 'separated, intervening' (alt. why: reviewer (minor): Reading of tam as "him" is not safe; the demonstrative may go with artham. Hindi/English are literal but near-unreadable; keep low confidence
